newsitem.title: USA: Protein Design to get milestone payment.
newsitem.headline: Protein Design to get milestone payment.

text.p: Protein Design Labs Inc said Wednesday it will receive a milestone payment from Roche Holding Ltd's Hoffman-La Roche unit, to reflect its filing for Food and Drug Administration approval of the Zenapax drug for kidney transplant patients.

Protein Design sold Hoffman-La Roche the exclusive worldwide license for dacliximab, the active ingredient in Zenapax. Hoffman La-Roche is seeking clearance to sell Zenapax as a drug to prevent rejection following kidney transplants.
Protein Design was not immediately available to disclose the size of the milestone payment it was due to receive.
